headlines.title: 英国经济7月意外增长 为伯纳姆政府带来好消息
headlines.summary: 尽管家庭能源账单大幅上涨，但英国经济在7月再次实现强劲增长，表现远超预期，各领域经济活动保持稳健。英国国家统计局周五公布，继6月增长0.3%之后，7月国内生产总值(GDP)增长了0.4%。这一结果远超分析师预期的持平。数据表明，经济增长已连续第三个月好于经济学家预期，暗示英国可能打破市场对其在2026年下半年大幅放缓的预期。当月服务业活动增长0.4%，工业生产增长0.2%，建筑业产出增长0.1%。

headlines.title_en: UK Economy Unexpectedly Grows in July, Good News for Burnham Government
headlines.summary_en: Despite a sharp rise in household energy bills, the UK economy again achieved strong growth in July, performing far better than expected, with activity remaining robust across sectors. The Office for National Statistics said Friday that GDP grew 0.4% in July, following 0.3% growth in June. That far exceeded analysts' expectations of flat growth. The data indicate that economic growth has beaten economists' forecasts for a third consecutive month, suggesting the UK may defy market expectations of a sharp slowdown in the second half of 2026. Services activity rose 0.4% in the month, industrial production grew 0.2%, and construction output rose 0.1%.

headlines.summary_zh: 中国8月份工厂出厂价格增速加快，而消费者通胀再次抬头，原因在于与美以对伊朗战争相关的能源和大宗商品成本波动。国家统计局周三发布的数据显示，上月生产者价格指数同比上涨3.8%，高于7月份的3.5%。

headlines.title: 分析师：CPI强弱或决定下周是否行动 美联储处境两难
headlines.summary: 分析师Mike Cahill指出，如果CPI数据表现更为强劲，且这一结果具有足够的广泛性，那么美联储可能会采取行动，因为这将偏离威廉姆斯和沃勒在今年夏季提出的政策框架。而如果数据更为疲软，应该足以让美联储维持利率不变，同时也不会引发市场的不利反应。但如果数据处于中间水平，情况就会更加棘手，因为市场已经明显对通胀率约为2.5%而美联储仍按兵不动的局面感到不安。总体而言，Cahill认为，美元走弱反映了几个因素，包括美联储倾向于维持利率不变，以及财政部已经表现出的政策偏好是，更倾向于让外汇市场进行调整，而不是让固定收益市场承担调整压力。

headlines.title_en: Analyst: CPI Strength May Determine Whether to Act Next Week; Fed in a Dilemma
headlines.summary_en: Analyst Mike Cahill noted that if the CPI data come in stronger and the result is broad-based enough, the Fed may act, as it would deviate from the policy framework proposed by Williams and Waller this summer. If the data are softer, that should be enough for the Fed to hold rates steady without triggering an adverse market reaction. But if the data land in the middle, the situation becomes trickier, because the market is already clearly uneasy about inflation at around 2.5% while the Fed remains on hold. Overall, Cahill believes the weaker dollar reflects several factors, including the Fed's inclination to keep rates unchanged and the Treasury's demonstrated policy preference for letting the FX market adjust rather than putting adjustment pressure on the fixed-income market.

headlines.title: 中国与塞舌尔签署《关于共同发展经济伙伴关系协定早期收获的安排》
headlines.summary: 9月10日，商务部部长王文涛与塞舌尔财政、经济规划、贸易和投资部部长拉波特签署《中华人民共和国政府与塞舌尔共和国政府关于共同发展经济伙伴关系协定早期收获的安排》，国际贸易谈判代表兼副部长李成钢与塞方会见，并交换早期收获安排文本。根据早期收获安排，中方将对塞方实施100%税目产品零关税，塞方也将进一步对中方开放市场。（商务部）

headlines.title_en: China and Seychelles Sign the Arrangement on Early Harvest of the Agreement on Economic Partnership for Shared Development
headlines.summary_en: On September 10, Commerce Minister Wang Wentao and Seychelles Minister of Finance, Economic Planning, Trade and Investment Laporte signed the "Arrangement on Early Harvest of the Agreement on Jointly Developing an Economic Partnership between the Government of the People's Republic of China and the Government of the Republic of Seychelles." International Trade Negotiation Representative and Vice Minister Li Chenggang met with the Seychelles side and exchanged the text of the early harvest arrangement. Under the early harvest arrangement, China will apply zero tariffs on 100% of tariff lines to Seychelles, and Seychelles will further open its market to China. (Ministry of Commerce)

headlines.title_en: UK Economy Unexpectedly Grows in July, Exceeding Market Expectations for a Third Consecutive Month
headlines.summary_en: The UK economy again recorded strong growth in July, far exceeding expectations, as activity remained broadly robust across sectors despite a sharp rise in household energy bills. The Office for National Statistics said Friday that GDP grew 0.4% in July after output rose 0.3% in June, far stronger than institutions' expectations of zero growth. The data mark a third consecutive month of growth beating economists' forecasts, meaning the UK may defy expectations of a sharp slowdown in the second half of 2026. That puts the UK economy on track to perform better than expected in the third quarter. Growth had previously been expected to slow sharply to 0.1%. The ONS said services activity rose 0.4%, industrial production grew 0.2%, and construction output rose 0.1%. headlines.title: 美国企业对特定垂直电力传输系统及其组成部分和下游计算机系统提起337调查申请

headlines.title_en: US Companies File Section 337 Investigation Application on Certain Vertical Power Transmission Systems, Components Thereof, and Downstream Computer Systems
headlines.summary_en: On September 9, 2026, US-based Vicor Corporation filed an application with the US International Trade Commission under Section 337 of the US Tariff Act of 1930, alleging that certain vertical power delivery systems, components thereof, and computing systems containing the same exported to, imported into, and sold in the US infringe its patent rights, and requesting the initiation of a Section 337 investigation and the issuance of a limited exclusion order and cease and desist order. Five Chinese companies are involved. (Ministry of Commerce)

headlines.title_en: MIIT: Will Implement Special Action to Raise Automotive Standards, Guide Enterprises Away from Reliance on Low-Price Path
headlines.summary_en: On September 11, the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology held a press conference to brief on the development of China's intelligent connected new energy vehicle industry. Guo Shougang, director of the First Equipment Industry Department of MIIT, said at the meeting that next, we will further strengthen departmental coordination and, with a nail-driving spirit, continue to advance work to regulate competition order in the auto industry and safeguard high-quality industrial development. First, continue to regulate industrial competition order. Deepen efforts to clean up online chaos in the industry and guide and standardize new vehicle launches and product review activities. Strengthen supervision and rectification of automakers that indirectly extend payment periods, and improve the standardization and institutionalization of payment terms. Increase regulatory and enforcement efforts against suspected violations of laws and regulations, and resolutely maintain a healthy, orderly, and clean market environment.

headlines.title_en: MIIT: Will Continue Pilot Programs for Intelligent Connected Vehicle Production Access and Road Operation, Steadily Advance Expansion of Scenarios Such as High-Speed Pilot
headlines.summary_en: On September 11, the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology held a press conference to brief on the development of China's intelligent connected new energy vehicle industry. Guo Shougang, director of the First Equipment Industry Department of MIIT, said at the meeting that next, MIIT will steadily and orderly implement mandatory national standards related to driver assistance and autonomous driving, optimize the access management system, and continuously strengthen safety supervision to ensure the safe and orderly development of the industry. headlines.title: 国家发改委：9月11日国内汽、柴油（标准品）价格每吨调控后实际上调260元、250元
headlines.summary: 据国家发改委，8月28日国内成品油价格调整以来，美伊冲突再度升级，国际市场原油价格持续大幅上涨。为减缓国际油价上涨对国内的冲击，在保持现行价格机制框架的基础上，对国内成品油价格采取临时调控措施。根据现行价格机制计算，9月11日国内汽、柴油（标准品）价格每吨分别应上调435元、420元，调控后实际上调260元、250元。

headlines.title_en: NDRC: On September 11, Domestic Gasoline and Diesel (Standard Products) Prices Actually Raised by 260 Yuan and 250 Yuan per Ton After Regulation
headlines.summary_en: According to the National Development and Reform Commission, since the domestic refined oil price adjustment on August 28, the US-Iran conflict has escalated again, and international crude oil prices have continued to rise sharply. To mitigate the impact of rising international oil prices on China, temporary regulatory measures have been adopted for domestic refined oil prices while maintaining the current price mechanism framework. Based on the current price mechanism, on September 11, domestic gasoline and diesel (standard products) prices should have risen by 435 yuan and 420 yuan per ton respectively; after regulation, they actually rose by 260 yuan and 250 yuan.

headlines.title_en: Minister of Commerce Wang Wentao Meets with Bulgarian Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Economy, Investment and Industry Pulev
headlines.summary_en: On the morning of September 10, Commerce Minister Wang Wentao met with Bulgarian Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Economy, Investment and Industry Plevneliev, and the two sides exchanged views on China-Bulgaria and China-EU economic and trade relations. Wang Wentao said China has noted that the EU business environment has continued to deteriorate in recent years, and that relevant legislation such as the Industrial Accelerator Act, the revised Cybersecurity Act, and foreign subsidy investigations have seriously affected Chinese enterprises' investment in Europe. Recently, the European Parliament released a report related to the Industrial Accelerator Act, proposing to significantly lower investment review thresholds in key areas such as electric vehicles, setting up obstacles in areas such as foreign shareholding and transfer of core technologies, and restricting non-EU companies from participating in public procurement. Recently, the two sides have been engaged in intensive negotiations under the framework of the China-EU trade and investment consultation mechanism. headlines.title: 人民币超过美元 成为最受哈萨克斯坦借款人青睐的融资货币
headlines.summary: 受更低的借贷成本和北京推进人民币国际化的影响，哈萨克斯坦借款人的人民币融资规模首次超过了美元融资规模。数据显示，今年迄今为止，哈萨克斯坦借款人发行的人民币债券规模已飙升至相当于34.4亿美元的水平，远高于2025年同期的4.56亿美元。而相比之下，美元融资额仅为31.6亿美元。（彭博）

headlines.title_en: The renminbi overtakes the US dollar to become the most favored financing currency for Kazakh borrowers
headlines.summary_en: Driven by lower borrowing costs and Beijing's push to internationalize the renminbi, Kazakh borrowers' renminbi financing has exceeded their dollar financing for the first time. Data shows that so far this year, renminbi bonds issued by Kazakh borrowers have surged to the equivalent of $3.44 billion, far above $456 million in the same period of 2025. By contrast, dollar financing was only $3.16 billion. (Bloomberg)

headlines.title: 上证报：外围扰动不改A股内在韧性
headlines.summary: 今日上午，A股调整幅度有所加大。何以出现“外围小跌、A股大跌”的背离？市场专业人士认为，更多来自情绪面的放大，而非估值或盈利的实质变化。在外围扰动加大的情况下，部分投资者信心仍待修复，容易在短期波动中产生恐慌情绪、跟风操作。有受访专家表示：“外部因素只是短期扰动，真正决定市场韧性的还是社会经济改革发展成效。总的来看A股基本面、政策面和资金面均稳健向好，外部扰动因素并不改变市场的内在韧性。”对于内在韧性来说，最核心的支撑是中国资产的安全溢价和强劲韧性。（上证报）

headlines.title_en: Shanghai Securities News: External disruptions will not change A-shares' inherent resilience
headlines.summary_en: This morning, the A-share adjustment widened somewhat. Why did the divergence of "small declines overseas, sharp declines in A-shares" occur? Market professionals believe it comes more from an amplification of sentiment than from substantive changes in valuations or earnings. Amid increased external disturbances, some investors' confidence still needs to be restored, making them prone to panic and herd behavior during short-term volatility. One interviewed expert said: "External factors are only short-term disturbances; what truly determines market resilience is the effectiveness of socioeconomic reform and development. Overall, the fundamentals, policy environment and liquidity conditions of A-shares are stable and improving, and external disturbances will not change the market's inherent resilience." For this inherent resilience, the most core support is the safety premium and strong resilience of Chinese assets. (Shanghai Securities News)

headlines.title: 美国8月CPI前瞻：能源涨价扰动通胀 美联储加息预期面临关键检验
headlines.summary: 【美国8月CPI前瞻：能源涨价扰动通胀 美联储加息预期面临关键检验】北京时间9月11日20时30分，美国将公布8月消费者价格指数（CPI）。在油价上涨、生产端价格压力持续的背景下，这份美联储9月议息会议前的关键通胀报告，将为利率决策提供重要依据，并牵动全球股债汇市场走势。

headlines.title_en: US August CPI Preview: Energy Price Increases Disturb Inflation, Fed Rate Hike Expectations Face Key Test
headlines.summary_en: [US August CPI Preview: Energy price increases disrupt inflation, Fed rate expectations face key test] At 20:30 Beijing time on September 11, the US will release the August Consumer Price Index (CPI). Against the backdrop of rising oil prices and persistent producer-side price pressure, this key inflation report before the Fed's September policy meeting will provide an important basis for interest rate decisions and affect global stock, bond, and currency market trends.
